responsibility: Defines the PowerPC ELF configuration layer for RTEMS. It installs RTEMS-specific predefined macros and assertions, adjusts the default small-data section used by libgcc, and redirects the CPP spec fragments so startup preprocessing receives RTEMS OS and CPU identifiers derived from -mcpu selections, making it the operating-system wrapper for PowerPC RTEMS targets on top of the SysV/ELF backend.
